scope: Root execution plan for independently selected scenario and risk controls. No new joint scenario equity output computed before this record.

mature_risk_control.selector: risk_rate_adjudication agent; independently frozen before outputs
mature_risk_control.classification: Sensitivity for successful risk maturation, not a measured term structure or new central case.

calculation_conventions.timing: Each annual future cash flow is divided by the product of(1+r_y) for each year after endpoint through cash year. Tail2041cash/(terminal_rate-.03), discounted through2040.
calculation_conventions.financing_benefit: Unchanged cash tax benefits; explicit annual same risk schedule, no-growth financing tail2041benefit/terminal_rate.
calculation_conventions.cash_claims: Use original endpoint treasury balances for endpoints<=2030 because post2030 operating controls leave earlier cash unchanged.
calculation_conventions.escrow_and_acquisition: Discount original finite future flows separately once.
calculation_conventions.capital_scenario: Await independently frozen operating policy; host-only post2030 net reinvestment changes, working capital included, packaging separate.
calculation_conventions.dividends_new_debt_new_shares: Unchanged zero forecast; no live short trade/account or borrow quote.

validation: Reproduce original end2026 and2030 values at11/12/13% before new controls; independently recheck delta math and discount products after computation.
